<thought>From the 13C NMR spectrum, the peaks at 134.30, 131.90, 128.20 (two equivalent carbons), and 127.40 (two equivalent carbons) fall within the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm). Counting each carbon gives 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 = 6 aromatic carbons. The remaining peak at 168.20 ppm is a carbonyl carbon, not aromatic.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
